messages.subject: Whitmore — consultation and grievance papers
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

As requested — the at-risk letter, the consultation notes, and the grievance outcome I issued on 2 December are on the shared drive. One thing you should know: an email from the East Region Operations Director referring to Rebecca as 'obstructive on the occupancy targets' was deleted from the live system but our IT team recovered it from backup. I'd rather that hadn't been written.

Lorna
